picture_tone.source: 290 Effect kind 5 (blink B / auto flash), e.g. TitleMap event 2 pc91 [80, 30, 12001, 12001, -50, -50, -50]
picture_tone.law: period = duration frames; percent ramps from 100+target to 100; byte = round(255*percent/100); colour = round(src*byte/255) per channel; alpha untouched (DxLib SetDrawBright semantics)
picture_tone.measured: byte = 128 + 127*(age % 30)/30 for the title banner, so it flashes twice per second; retail frame 21_21_35 caught byte 222 and another capture caught 188
picture_tone.unreachable: 222 is not exactly reachable with a 30 frame period (step ~4.23); 221 is the nearest phase and leaves a 1-byte residual
picture_tone.note: pixel comparisons against the retail PrintScreen must be taken at frame % 30 == 26 while the title menu is parked, or the phase, not the renderer, decides the score

picture_erase.rule: 150 [head, number, fade] erases one slot; 150 [head, number, fade, _, _, other] erases the inclusive range min(number, other)..max(number, other) - the interpreter hands the layer the arguments after the head, so the second picture number is PictureCmd.args[3]
picture_erase.proof: ce221 pc36 150 [16777218, 50000, 5, 5, 0, 50003] clears the whole loading screen 50000..50003 in one command, which is why 50001/50002 are never erased individually
picture_erase.unordered_pairs: only 4 sites carry A > B (Map003 ev1 pc24 (-1,-2); SampleMapA ev15 pc102/388/656 (20007,20003)), hence min/max
picture_erase.earlier_note: an earlier note quoted 1,115 / 751 / 329 / 35: that scan only counted erases whose endpoints bracket a picture that is actually drawn somewhere, which is a narrower filter than "every erase in the 550 common events"
